---
title: "Racial and Ethnic Groups in Recessions Abroad: Canada, the United Kingdom and Israel"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Unemployment by racial or ethnic group from the three peer economies whose labour force surveys publish it, for the
# panel at the foot of the international page (#intl). No keys are needed. Writes data/race_abroad.json; a source that
# cannot be reached keeps its previous values.
#   Canada: Statistics Canada, Labour Force Survey, table 14-10-0373-01: racialized ("visible minority") groups, aged 15
#           and over, three-month moving averages, not seasonally adjusted. The table begins in 2022.
#   United Kingdom: Office for National Statistics, Labour Force Survey, dataset A09: ethnic group, aged 16 and over,
#           quarterly, not seasonally adjusted, from July to September 2001.
#   Israel: Central Bureau of Statistics, monthly Labour Force Survey (time-series API, subject 11): the labour force and
#           the unemployed aged 15 and over, for the whole population and for Jews. The rest of the population (Arab
#           citizens and others) is the difference. The 2012-2025 series is joined to the current one where it begins.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table); library(jsonlite); library(readxl)
options(timeout = 600, HTTPUserAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) inequalityofrecession.com data update")
root <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), ".."))
dest <- file.path(root, "data", "race_abroad.json")
old <- if (file.exists(dest)) fromJSON(dest, simplifyVector = FALSE) else list()
mi <- function(y, m) as.integer(y) * 12L + as.integer(m) - 1L                  # month index
ym <- function(t) sprintf("%04d-%02d", t %/% 12L, t %% 12L + 1L)
grab <- function(name, expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) { message(name, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); old[[name]] })
```

## Canada

```{r canada}
ca <- grab("ca", {
  zipf <- file.path(tempdir(), "14100373-eng.zip")
  download.file("https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/tbl/csv/14100373-eng.zip", zipf, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  d <- fread(grep("14100373\\.csv$", unzip(zipf, exdir = tempdir()), value = TRUE), encoding = "UTF-8",
             select = c("REF_DATE", "GEO", "Labour force characteristics", "Age group", "Gender", "Population group", "VALUE"))
  d <- d[GEO == "Canada" & get("Labour force characteristics") == "Unemployment rate" & get("Age group") == "15 years and over" & Gender == "Total - Gender"]
  d[, t := mi(substr(REF_DATE, 1, 4), substr(REF_DATE, 6, 7))]
  t0 <- min(d$t); t1 <- max(d$t)
  keep <- c("Total population", "Not a visible minority", "Visible minority population", "Black", "South Asian", "Chinese", "Filipino", "Arab", "Latin American", "Southeast Asian", "West Asian")
  g <- lapply(setNames(keep, keep), function(k) { x <- d[get("Population group") == k]; v <- rep(NA_real_, t1 - t0 + 1L); v[x$t - t0 + 1L] <- x$VALUE; v })
  list(start = ym(t0), step = 1L, groups = g, source = "Statistics Canada, Labour Force Survey, table 14-10-0373-01")
})
```

## United Kingdom

```{r uk}
uk <- grab("uk", {
  page <- paste(readLines("https://www.ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/datasets/labourmarketstatusbyethnicgroupa09", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
  link <- regmatches(page, regexpr("/file\\?uri=/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/datasets/labourmarketstatusbyethnicgroupa09/current/[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\.xlsx?", page))
  if (!length(link)) stop("no A09 file on the dataset page")
  f <- file.path(tempdir(), sub(".*/", "", link))
  download.file(paste0("https://www.ons.gov.uk", link), f, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  x <- as.data.frame(read_excel(f, sheet = grep("People-Unemployment", excel_sheets(f), value = TRUE)[1], col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text"))
  # each row is dated by its own label; footnote markers can follow the year ("Jan-Mar 20195")
  lab <- trimws(x[[1]]); m <- regmatches(lab, regexec("^(Jan|Apr|Jul|Oct)-(Mar|Jun|Sep|Dec) ([0-9]{4})", lab))
  rows <- which(lengths(m) == 4L)
  t <- mi(vapply(m[rows], `[`, "", 4L), c(Jan = 2, Apr = 5, Jul = 8, Oct = 11)[vapply(m[rows], `[`, "", 2L)])   # middle month of each quarter
  rc <- which(vapply(x, function(col) any(trimws(col) == "Rates", na.rm = TRUE), logical(1)))[1]   # the rates block (aged 16+)
  hdr <- which(grepl("^Total", trimws(x[[rc]])))[1]
  cols <- rc:(rc + 9L); nm <- sub("[0-9]+$", "", trimws(unlist(x[hdr, cols])))
  v <- lapply(cols, function(cc) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[rows, cc])))
  t0 <- min(t[!is.na(v[[1]])]); grid <- seq(t0, max(t), by = 3L)
  if (anyDuplicated(t)) stop("a quarter appears twice in A09")
  g <- setNames(lapply(v, function(z) round(z[match(grid, t)], 3)), nm)
  list(start = ym(t0), step = 3L, groups = g, file = sub(".*/", "", link), source = "Office for National Statistics, Labour Force Survey, A09")
})
```

## Israel

```{r israel}
il <- grab("il", {
  series <- function(p) {
    r <- fromJSON(paste0("https://apis.cbs.gov.il/series/data/path?id=", p, "&format=json&download=false&lang=en&pagesize=1000"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
    o <- r$DataSet$Series[[1]]$obs
    data.table(t = vapply(o, function(z) mi(substr(z$TimePeriod, 1, 4), substr(z$TimePeriod, 6, 7)), integer(1)),
               v = vapply(o, function(z) if (is.null(z$Value)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(z$Value), numeric(1)))
  }
  rates <- function(l2) {   # unemployment rates from the labour force (4th level 2) and the unemployed (4th level 5)
    s <- lapply(c(UA = "5,2226", UJ = "5,2238", LA = "2,2226", LJ = "2,2238"), function(z) series(paste0("11,", l2, ",1,", z)))
    m <- Reduce(function(a, b) merge(a, b, by = "t"), lapply(names(s), function(k) setnames(copy(s[[k]]), "v", k)))
    m[, .(t, Jews = 100 * UJ / LJ, Others = 100 * (UA - UJ) / (LA - LJ), All = 100 * UA / LA)]
  }
  a <- rates(5); b <- rates(6)
  h <- if (min(a$t) <= min(b$t)) a else b; cur <- if (identical(h, a)) b else a      # the long history, then the current series
  m <- rbind(h[t < min(cur$t)], cur)[order(t)]
  t0 <- min(m$t); full <- data.table(t = t0:max(m$t)); m <- m[full, on = "t"]
  list(start = ym(t0), step = 1L, splice = ym(min(cur$t)),
       groups = list(Jews = round(m$Jews, 3), `Arab citizens and others` = round(m$Others, 3), All = round(m$All, 3)),
       source = "Central Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force Survey (time-series API, subject 11)")
})
```

## Write

```{r write}
res <- list(updated = format(Sys.Date()), ca = ca, uk = uk, il = il)
write_json(res, dest, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA, na = "null")
str(lapply(res[c("ca", "uk", "il")], function(z) list(start = z$start, step = z$step, n = length(z$groups[[1]]), groups = names(z$groups))))
```
